notes: P05 task SACMAT-X09_minimizer (Delta-debugging temporal witness minimizer for RQ1). evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/temporal_witness_minimizer.py (TEMPORAL_WITNESS_MINIMIZER_VERSION clara.sacmat.temporal-witness-minimizer-v1) implements delta-debugging (ddmin) over ordered policy-trace events without deleting required granting context via minimize_witness(failing_trace, oracle) -> MinimizedTrace, minimize(trace, predicate) -> PolicyTrace, and is_1_minimal(trace, oracle) -> bool. Guarantees: minimized trace still exposes the SAME semantic fault on the oracle; length is <= original length; removing any further event eliminates the fault (1-minimal). Preserves required granting context without deleting prerequisites by enforcing that candidate traces reproduce the exact fault without introducing spurious defects. Fail-closed error surface with stable reason codes on MinimizerError: NO_FAULT_DETECTED, NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS, EMPTY_TRACE, MALFORMED_TRACE, SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH, TARGET_FAULT_NOT_FOUND. Test driver evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/test_temporal_witness_minimizer.py (17 tests, all passed): positive controls proving 10-event traces minimized to 3 essential events (DELEGATION_CYCLE with root granting context preserved), 2 essential events (ungranted cycle and custom predicate), 4 essential events (REVOKED_ACTOR_TRANSITIVITY), convenience contract, JSON-serializability (to_dict), determinism and idempotence; adversarial controls proving fail-closed rejections on traces without fault (PERMIT with zero findings), false predicates, non-monotonic timestamps (unordered and duplicate), empty traces, target fault mismatch, and malformed inputs. Full sacmat suite: 311 passed. oracle_disagreement_count=0: candidate minimizer matches reference DSL oracle exactly. baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE (witness reduction utility). source_sha_after records the base commit 4f5ad0ab per the sibling convention; the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report.
